tips.label: 問天氣
tips.text: 用 How is/was the weather ...? 或 What is/was the weather like ...? 來問天氣。

tips.label: 回答天氣
tips.text: 用 It is/was + 天氣形容詞回答，例如 It was rainy. 注意這裡用 It，不用 This 或 That。

tips.label: 易混淆句型
tips.text: It rains/rained 的 rain 是動詞；It is/was rainy 的 rainy 是形容詞。There is/was＋rain/snow；We/They have/had＋rain/snow。先看主詞，再看時間。

notes.title: How 與 What 詢問天氣
notes.rule: How + be 動詞 + the weather + 地點副詞 + 時間副詞？／What + be 動詞 + the weather + like + 地點副詞 + 時間副詞？
notes.description: How 的問句不能加 like；What 的問句一定要加 like。be 動詞依時間改成 is 或 was。
examples: How is the weather in Taipei today?
What was the weather like in Hsinchu last night?
How was the weather in Australia in summer?

notes.title: 回答天氣狀況
notes.rule: It + is / was + 天氣形容詞。
notes.description: 談天氣時用代名詞 It 代替 the weather。今天、現在等現在時間用 is；昨天、上週等過去時間用 was。
examples: It was rainy and wet yesterday.

notes.title: 描述雨量與雪量
notes.rule: It + rains/rained/snows/snowed + a lot/a little + 地點副詞 + 時間副詞。
notes.description: rain 與 snow 在這個句型是動詞；現在習慣或事實用 rains/snows，過去發生的事用 rained/snowed。snowy 是形容詞，必須搭配 It is/was snowy，後面不能再直接接 a lot 或 a little。
examples: It rains a lot in Taipei in winter.
It snowed a little in the mountains yesterday.

notes.title: There is/was 與 have 描述雨雪
notes.rule: There + is/was + a lot of/much/a little + rain/snow。／We/They + have + a lot of/much/a little + rain/snow。
notes.description: rain 與 snow 在這裡是不可數名詞，搭配 much、a little 或 a lot of，不用 many 或 a few。There 開頭用 is/was；We/They 開頭用 have/had。現在習慣如 every winter 用 is/have；過去時間如 last winter 用 was/had。問句是 Is/Was there ...? 或 Do/Did we/they have ...?；did 後的 have 用原形。
examples: There was a lot of rain last summer.
We have much rain in spring.
They had a little snow in January.

quiz.question: ___ is the weather near your school today?
quiz.hint: 沒有 like 的天氣問句用 How is the weather。

quiz.question: ___ was the weather like during the school trip?
quiz.hint: 有 like 的天氣問句用 What was the weather like。

quiz.question: How ___ the weather on the island right now?
quiz.hint: right now 指現在；How 問天氣搭配 is。

quiz.question: What ___ the weather like last Saturday?
quiz.hint: last Saturday 指過去，天氣問句用 was。

quiz.question: What is the weather ___ in your country today?
quiz.hint: What is the weather like 是固定的天氣問句，like 不作動詞變化。

quiz.question: How ___ the weather during your trip last month?
quiz.hint: last month 是過去時間，How 後用 was 問天氣。

quiz.question: ___ is the weather like outside? Is it sunny?
quiz.hint: 後面有 like，因此句首用 What。

quiz.question: ___ was the weather before the heavy shower?
quiz.hint: 句中沒有 like，用 How was the weather 詢問過去天氣。

quiz.question: A: What was the weather ___ yesterday? B: It was windy.
quiz.hint: What was the weather like 詢問過去天氣；like 不變成 liked。

quiz.question: A: ___ is the weather today? B: It is cloudy.
quiz.hint: 回答描述天氣，且問句沒有 like，要用 How。

quiz.question: It ___ sunny outside at the moment.
quiz.hint: at the moment 指現在；sunny 是形容詞，搭配 is。

quiz.question: It ___ windy during the picnic yesterday.
quiz.hint: yesterday 指過去，windy 前用 was。

quiz.question: It is ___ in the mountains today.
quiz.hint: is 後接天氣形容詞 snowy。

quiz.question: It was ___ when we left home yesterday.
quiz.hint: was 後接形容詞 rainy；動詞 rained 不放在 was 後。

quiz.question: It ___ cloudy here right now.
quiz.hint: right now 用現在式，主詞 It 搭配 is。

quiz.question: It ___ cold at the lake last night.
quiz.hint: last night 用過去式，主詞 It 搭配 was。

quiz.question: It is usually ___ here in spring.
quiz.hint: usually 不改變句型，is 後仍用形容詞 rainy。

quiz.question: It was ___ on the mountain during our winter trip.
quiz.hint: was 後接形容詞 snowy 描述天氣。

quiz.question: A: Was it sunny yesterday? B: No, it ___. It was cloudy.
quiz.hint: 問句用 Was，否定簡答用 wasn't。

quiz.question: A: Is it windy outside now? B: Yes, it ___.
quiz.hint: Is it 的現在式問句，肯定簡答用 it is。

quiz.question: It ___ a lot here every May.
quiz.hint: every May 表示習慣，主詞 It 的現在式動詞加 s。

quiz.question: It ___ heavily in our town last Tuesday.
quiz.hint: last Tuesday 是過去時間，用 rained。

quiz.question: It ___ in these mountains every winter.
quiz.hint: every winter 表示習慣，It 搭配 snows。

quiz.question: It ___ on the farm two days ago.
quiz.hint: two days ago 指過去，用 snowed。

quiz.question: Does it ___ much here in summer?
quiz.hint: 助動詞 Does 後用原形 rain。

quiz.question: Did it ___ during your mountain trip last week?
quiz.hint: Did 已表示過去，後面用原形 snow。

quiz.question: It doesn't ___ much here in autumn.
quiz.hint: doesn't 後的主要動詞用原形 rain。

quiz.question: It didn't ___ here last winter.
quiz.hint: didn't 後用原形 snow，不再變成過去式。

quiz.question: ___ it rain a lot in your country every spring?
quiz.hint: every spring 表示習慣；It 的一般動詞問句用 Does。

quiz.question: ___ it snow near the lake last night?
quiz.hint: last night 表示過去，snow 是一般動詞，問句用 Did。

quiz.question: A: Did it rain yesterday? B: Yes, it ___.
quiz.hint: Did it rain 的肯定簡答用 it did。

quiz.question: A: Does it snow here every winter? B: No, it ___.
quiz.hint: Does it 的否定簡答用 it doesn't。

quiz.question: The weather report says it often ___ here in June.
quiz.hint: often 表示習慣，It 搭配第三人稱單數 rains。

quiz.question: The roads were wet because it ___ last night.
quiz.hint: last night 是過去時間，用 rained。

quiz.question: There ___ a lot of rain in our town every spring.
quiz.hint: There 描述雨量用 be 動詞；every spring 表示習慣，不可數 rain 搭配 is。

quiz.question: There ___ a little snow on the hill last night.
quiz.hint: There 搭配 be 動詞；last night 指過去，snow 不可數，用 was。

quiz.question: There ___ a lot of snow on the mountain right now.
quiz.hint: right now 表示現在；There 後不可用 have，snow 不可數，用 is。

quiz.question: There ___ heavy rain during our trip last weekend.
quiz.hint: last weekend 是過去時間；There 與不可數 rain 搭配 was。

quiz.question: There ___ usually a little rain here in autumn.
quiz.hint: usually 表示習慣；There 後搭配 is，不用 have。

quiz.question: There ___ very little rain in the village last summer.
quiz.hint: last summer 表示過去，There 後用 was 描述雨量。

quiz.question: We ___ a lot of rain here every April.
quiz.hint: 主詞 We 描述某地雨量用 have；every April 表示現在的習慣。

quiz.question: We ___ heavy rain during our vacation last month.
quiz.hint: 主詞 We 搭配 have／had；last month 指過去，用 had。

quiz.question: They ___ a little snow in their town every winter.
quiz.hint: 主詞 They 描述當地雪量用 have；every winter 表示習慣。

quiz.question: They ___ a lot of snow in their village last January.
quiz.hint: last January 指過去；They 後用 had 描述雪量。

quiz.question: We usually ___ very little rain here in winter.
quiz.hint: usually 表示習慣；We 後用 have，不用 is 或 are 接雨量。

quiz.question: They ___ heavy rain in their town two days ago.
quiz.hint: two days ago 指過去；They 後用 had。

quiz.question: There was ___ rain last night.
quiz.hint: rain 在這裡是不可數名詞，用 a little；其他選項修飾可數複數名詞。

quiz.question: We didn't have ___ snow here last winter.
quiz.hint: snow 是不可數名詞，否定句中的雪量可用 much。

quiz.question: Did they ___ much rain in their town last week?
quiz.hint: Did 後用原形 have，不再用 had。

quiz.question: Was there ___ snow on the mountain yesterday?
quiz.hint: snow 是不可數名詞，問句中用 much 表示雪量。
